note: The nations of Ostrel for diplomacy (src/command/diplomacy.ts). Blurbs say only what anyone in Ostrel knows: no storyline, no twists. 'known' is the story stage from which they show; 'land' is the map their seat is on (a pact or a march needs the way there open); 'price' is what they ask; 'deed' parts are story flags their own storyline will set; 'perk' is what a pact gives; 'march' is the army battle to take them by force.

nations.name: The Cloudline Clans
nations.blurb: Terrace villages above the cloud sea. They grow duskwort and sell it to the Guild at a price their grandparents agreed to.

price.text: Help them pay down what they owe the Guild for the duskwort, and send grain for the lean months.

perk.text: Grain from the terraces each time the story moves on (5 supplies), and a company of clan slingers for your battles.

nations.name: Millbridge
nations.blurb: The market town on the Kerrow. It trades with anyone who keeps faith with it, and remembers who doesn't.

price.text: Stand by the town when it counts, and send grain to its stores for the winter.

or.text: Or bring the man who led the Wardens to Larkfold to stand trial there.

perk.text: River tolls (4 coin each time the story moves on), 15% off at Millbridge's stalls, and the town militia for your battles.

nations.name: The Millcities
nations.blurb: Cinderwick and Lockside: mills, canals and foundries. The owners hold the purse; the mill hands hold the looms.

flags.text: Corvel's hatchery at Lockside held against the Wardens.

price.text: Show the Commons can protect the canal towns, and put coin into the cellar clinics.

perk.text: A share of the canal dues (6 coin), 15% off at the Cinderwick and Lockside stalls, and a company of mill hands with pikes.

nations.name: The Brood Guild
nations.blurb: The Houses that breed the lulls. The Commons is at war with them; no envoy of yours would come back.

price.text: No terms. This is the war.

nations.name: The Crown of Ostrel
nations.blurb: A young king at Kingsmere, crowned two years ago, and a court where everyone is owed something.

flags.text: Something the king will only ask in person, at Kingsmere.

price.text: A king's terms are given face to face.

perk.text: The Crown's seal on the Commons' cause, and a share of the crown rents (10 coin).

nations.name: The Corvane League
nations.blurb: The banking houses of the hill towns. Half of Ostrel owes them money, and they'd like to know who'll pay it back.

flags.text: A matter of their ledgers, settled at Corvane.

price.text: Bankers want proof you'll still be standing when the debts come due.

perk.text: Credit from the League (12 coin each time the story moves on).

nations.name: The Hollin Free Towns
nations.blurb: Towns of the fens that decide everything by a public vote on the square, and keep to what they vote.

flags.text: Win the vote on Hollin's square.

price.text: Hollin joins whoever wins the vote on its square.

perk.text: Fen grain (4 supplies) and a company of fen bows.

nations.name: The College of Physicians
nations.blurb: Ostrel's doctors. They license who may treat the sick, and they have never said a word against the Guild.

flags.text: A question of evidence, settled at the College.

perk.text: Medicines from the College (3 supplies each time the story moves on).

nations.name: The Drevka Clans
nations.blurb: Highland riders of the north. They follow strength, and their champion speaks for them.

flags.text: Face their champion, in the north.

price.text: The clans follow whoever beats their champion.

nations.name: The Ember Courts
nations.blurb: The desert courts beyond the steppe: rich, proud, and very good customers of the Guild.

flags.text: A matter at court, settled in the desert.

price.text: The courts deal only in person.

perk.text: Ember gold (15 coin each time the story moves on).

nations.name: Tarsis
nations.blurb: A fortress of sellswords on the steppe. They fight for whoever pays, and right now that's the Guild.

flags.text: Their contract with the Guild has to end first.

price.text: Outbid the Guild when the contract runs out.

nations.name: Port Ashby
nations.blurb: The harbour town on the Salt Coast. Everything that goes by sea goes through Ashby, both ways.

flags.text: A promise about the harbour, made in person.

price.text: Ashby wants to know what the harbour gets after the war.

perk.text: Harbour dues (8 coin each time the story moves on).

nations.name: The Kingdom of Lorne
nations.blurb: The cold kingdom in the far north. Lorne hangs anyone found with a lull ring.

flags.text: Prove to Lorne's courts that the ringed can be weaned.

price.text: Lorne would have to change its law.
